# v1.6.0 — Override the current model's context window & max output tokens

> **zread-pi 1.6.0**: the pi-ai catalog carries accurate `contextWindow` / `maxTokens` for built-in
> models, but catalog-unknown models (legacy configs, third-party gateways) only get fallback values
> (200k / 8192), and many OpenAI-compatible gateways quietly discount the real limits. You can now
> override both for the **active model** from the config UI: `/config/model-size`.

## 🔧 What changed

| Area | Before (v1.5.3) | Now (v1.6.0) |
|---|---|---|
| `~/.zread-pi/config.yaml` | no per-model size knobs | `llm.context_window` / `llm.max_tokens` (optional; `null` = follow catalog metadata) |
| Config UI | context/output only editable per **custom model** definition | new `/config/model-size` page for the **active model** (two fields, catalog defaults shown, `d` resets, empty = follow default) |
| Runtime | model metadata came from the catalog / fallback only | overrides patch the resolved model, so the request output limit, the compaction threshold and the generate-page "context ratio" denominator all follow it |

- Precedence: explicit override > catalog metadata (incl. custom-model definitions) > fallback default.
- The request output limit is still clamped by pi-ai (`clampMaxTokensToContext`:
  `contextWindow - used - 4096`), so shrinking the window may also shrink the output ceiling.
- Distinct from `agent.token_budget`: `max_tokens` caps a **single request**, `token_budget` caps the
  **whole agent run** (soft/hard notices + forced finalization).

## 📦 Install

```bash
# Option 1: standalone binary (zip attached to this release, unzip and run)
#   zread-pi-v1.6.0-windows-x64.zip / linux-x64 / macos-arm64

# Option 2: from source
bun install
bun run vendor:build
bun run cli --dir <target-repo>
```

# v1.6.0 —— 可在配置界面覆盖当前模型的上下文窗口与最大输出 tokens

> **zread-pi 1.6.0**：pi-ai 目录为内置模型提供准确的 `contextWindow` / `maxTokens`，但目录外的模型
> （旧配置 / 第三方网关）只能拿到回退值（200k / 8192），而很多 OpenAI 兼容网关还会悄悄打折真实的
> 上下文/输出上限。现在可以在配置界面为**当前生效模型**覆盖这两项：`/config/model-size`。

## 🔧 改动内容

| 位置 | 之前（v1.5.3） | 现在（v1.6.0） |
|---|---|---|
| `~/.zread-pi/config.yaml` | 没有模型尺寸旋钮 | `llm.context_window` / `llm.max_tokens`（可选；`null` = 跟随模型目录元数据） |
| 配置界面 | 只能按**自定义模型定义**改上下文/输出 | 新增 `/config/model-size`，针对**当前生效模型**（两个输入框 + 目录默认值提示，`d` 恢复默认，留空 = 跟随默认） |
| 运行时 | 模型元数据只来自目录 / 回退值 | 覆盖值 patch 到解析出的模型上：请求输出上限、上下文压缩阈值与生成页「上下文占比」分母一律跟随覆盖值 |

- 优先级：显式覆盖 > 目录元数据（含自定义模型定义）> 回退默认值。
- 请求输出上限仍会被 pi-ai 钳制（`clampMaxTokensToContext`：`contextWindow - 已用 - 4096`），
  因此把窗口改小可能连带把输出上限压低。
- 与 `agent.token_budget` 的区别：`max_tokens` 限制**单次请求**的输出，`token_budget` 限制
  **整次 Agent 运行**的累计 token（软/硬提示 + 强制交卷）。

## 📦 安装

```bash
# 方式一：standalone 二进制（本 Release 附带的 zip，解压即用）
#   zread-pi-v1.6.0-windows-x64.zip / linux-x64 / macos-arm64

# 方式二：从源码运行
bun install
bun run vendor:build
bun run cli --dir <目标仓库>
```
